title: The morphine party and his cousin's arrest
summary: At a party he was injected with morphine; he stole supplies with his cousin until the cousin went to prison.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: He gives a signal. I guess a club rap at the door, you know, they open the door and let him in. I got in there and they had one of these huge dining room tables with all of the leafs added to it, you know. And everyone is around it, and glasses of bloody water. I say oh, oh, what have I let myself in for? You know, and I see them sticking these needles in

their arms and things. Well I can't chicken out. So I went on and sat down. He tied me up, which shouldn't happen to a dog. I wouldn't do that to anyone. Even through my addiction, I never ed turn anyone on. Never had any. Well at that time you could buy morphine in the drug store without prescription. Pure morphine, not morphine sulfate like they use here in hospitals, I mean pure morphine.

And it came in the size of like a cube of sugar. And you shave it off, you know. What you wanted. So I got loaded, started scratching and gigling. Of course I never had a feeling like this. But I didn't have any sexual desires, with all these pretty girls around the table.
How many -- so this was your cousin and his friends, how many people were there doing this?
Were they in your age group.
No they were in his age group.
Oh about 21, 22. So he and I after I started using, he'd take me with him. We'd break seals on box cars and furnish hotels with supplies, you know, in order to get more morphine. So he got arrested.
Now, in the meanwhile, his mother was dealing. And
that that he couldn't steal from her, he'd have to go out and buy from the drugstore. He and his brother were stealing all of her dope. The brother's name was Sterling. His name was Van.

Anyway, he got busted and got sent to McAlistor State Penitentiary and left me out there in the streets with an eight-month habit. And I'm a juvenile, I can't go into any drug store and get no morphine. (Laughter).
